title: The Harvest Loaves

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: The big day is nearly here! Today I bake every kind of loaf there is.

intro.speaker: tobias
intro.text: Will you load the oven one last time? Every loaf has a place just its shape.

steps.speaker: tobias
steps.prompt: Put each loaf in the place that fits its shape.
steps.hint: Watch: the long loaf goes in the long place. Can you find the next?

feedback.all_good: A full oven, one last time this year! Thank you, my faithful helper.

outro.speaker: tobias
outro.text: Bread for the feast, baked with flour from our own fields. Now there's nothing left but to wait for our friends.

journal_line: I loaded the oven with the harvest loaves with Mr. Tobias.
